'''Jordi Aláez Peña''' (born 23 January 1998) is an Andorran professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes|Atlètic d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Playing career==

===Club career===
Aláez quickly progressed through the youth ranks of [[FC Andorra]], a club based in [[Andorra]] but playing in the [[Spanish football league system]]. As part of the "juvenile" (U18) team, he helped them achieve a near perfect season (25 wins, 3 draws, 1 loss) in 2014–15 to achieve promotion to the third-tier.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/44382/esforc-i-humilitat-les-claus-de-lascens|title=Esforç i humilitat, les claus de l'ascens|first=Albert|last=Canes|publisher=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|date=May 29, 2015|access-date=June 20, 2016|language=ca}}</ref>  He was called up to the first squad (playing in the fifth-tier [[Primera Catalana]]) before the start of the 2015–16 season. He made his debut less than a month after his 18th birthday, replacing [[Alexandre Martínez]] in the 79' of a 4–0 home win against [[UA Horta]] on 14 February 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lapreferente.com/P1022117/2015-2016/fc-andorra-vs-ua-horta|title=F.C. Andorra 4 - U.A. Horta 0|publisher=La Preferente|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=es}}</ref>

===International career===

====Youth====

Aláez made his debut for the [[Andorra national under-17 football team|Andorra national under-17 team]] in October 2013, playing all three matches in the [[2014 UEFA European Under-17 Championship qualifying round|2014 Euro U17 qualifiers]] (against [[Serbia national under-17 football team|Serbia]], [[Greece national under-17 football team|Greece]] and [[Estonia national under-17 football team|Estonia]], respectively).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1005438&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301#.V2bdHtIrJdg|title=Convocatòria de la selecció sub17 per la fase que tindrà lloc a Sèrbia|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=September 26, 2013|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1005441&cod_primaria=3000316&cod_secundaria=3000316#.V2bcQ9IrJdg|title=La selecció sub17 mereix l'empat contra la favorita Grècia que marca al 79'|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=October 3, 2013|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref> He was 15 years old. He subsequently captained Andorra U17 at the [[2015 UEFA European Under-17 Championship qualifying round|following year's qualifiers]],<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1005758&cod_primaria=3000316&cod_secundaria=3000678#.V2bn6NIrJdg|title=Romania només pot superar a Andorra de penal en la clausura del mini-torneig|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=September 30, 2015|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref> recording one assist in three games as they failed to pass the group stage once again.

He also appeared in five matches for the [[Andorra national under-19 football team|Andorra national under-19 team]], three times in the [[2015 UEFA European Under-19 Championship qualification|2015 Euro U19 qualifiers]] in [[Poland]] and twice in the [[2016 UEFA European Under-19 Championship qualification|2016 Euro 19 qualifiers]] in [[Romania]].

His debut with the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|Andorra national under-21 team]] was on 26 March 2015, where he played the full 90 minutes in a 1–0 loss to the [[Republic of Ireland national under-21 football team|Republic of Ireland]].

====Senior====
Aláez made his senior international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] by playing the full 90 minutes of a 0–0 draw in a friendly against [[Azerbaijan national football team|Azerbaijan]] on 26 May 2016.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://cadenaser.com/emisora/2016/05/27/radio_ser_principat_d_andorra/1464362405_547791.html|title=La selecció andorrana de futbol empata davant d'Azerbaidjan|publisher=[[Cadena SER]]|date=March 26, 2016|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2016/05/27/una_solida_andorra_empata_sense_gols_contra_azerbaidjan_102555_1128.html|title=Una sòlida Andorra empata sense gols contra l'Azerbaidjan|publisher=[[Diari d'Andorra]]|date=May 27, 2016|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref> Aláez was among the four "fresh faces" with no previous senior international experience that manager [[Koldo Álvarez]] decided to include in the 18-man squad the day before the match, showing great confidence in the young players.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2016/05/25/koldo_obre_porta_als_joves_alaez_martinez_matos_102466_1128.html|title=Koldo obre la porta als joves Aláez, Martínez i Matos|first=Sergi|last=Cano|publisher=[[Diari d'Andorra]]|date=May 26, 2016|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.andorradifusio.ad/Esports/koldo-alvarez-aposta-per-les-cares-noves-a-lamistos-contra-lazerbaidjan|title=Koldo Álvarez aposta per les cares noves a l'amistós contra l'Azerbaidjan|publisher=Andorra Difusió|date=May 19, 2016|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref> He earned his second cap a week later, coming on as a 65th-minute substitute for Alexandre Martínez during a 2–0 loss to [[Estonia national football team|Estonia]] in [[Tallinn]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1006728&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301#.V2d0EtIrJdg|title=Derrota ajustada de la Selecció a Tallinn en el centenari d'Ilde Lima (2-0)|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=June 1, 2016|access-date=June 19, 2016|language=ca}}</ref>
